parameters.name: SSCTemplateID
parameters.description: Static and persistent ID element. At most one {{object}} instance can exist with a given value for {{param}}.

parameters.name: SSCEnable
parameters.description: If set to {{false}}, then all BSSs that are linked with this {{object}} are disabled, which means that these BSSs cease to offer service.

parameters.name: VID
parameters.description: The VLAN ID (VID) for all BSSs that are part of this {{object}}. A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN shall be configured on the BSSs belonging to this {{object}}.

parameters.name: HaulType
parameters.description: Indicates the use of the BSSs that are part of this {{object}}. {{list}}{{enum}}

object.description: Table of Service Set Collection (SSC) templates (SSCTemplate) for Wi-Fi configuration.
